script: Format: vertical 9:16 or 4:5, about 22 seconds. Show each image full screen, 3 to 4 seconds each, with a gentle zoom.
Music: soft upbeat instrumental, low volume. Add captions in English.
Opening (3s): From purchase to plate, every gram tracked
Slide 1 (4s) - on screen: Buy | voice-over: Raise a purchase order with your supplier.
Slide 2 (4s) - on screen: Receive | voice-over: Goods received update stock and ingredient price.
Slide 3 (4s) - on screen: Cook and sell | voice-over: Recipes deduct the right amounts with every sale.
Slide 4 (4s) - on screen: Count and compare | voice-over: Stock counts show the difference against the system.
Closing (3s): Try the free demo. First month free after installation. Call Md. Sakir Ahmed +880 1575-888775
